exercises.name: Seated partial stand
exercises.cue: Lean forward, nose over toes, and lift your hips just off the seat.

exercises.name: Sit to stand, high chair
exercises.cue: Hands on your thighs to help. Stand tall, then sit back slowly.

exercises.name: Sit to stand
exercises.cue: Arms crossed, feet flat. Stand up tall, then lower slowly to the seat.

exercises.name: Box squat
exercises.cue: Sit back until you just touch the box, then drive up through your heels.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.cue: Hold the weight at your chest, elbows down. Sit between your heels.

exercises.name: Slow goblet squat
exercises.cue: Three seconds down, a short pause, then stand.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cue: Press the plate away without locking your knees, then let it come back slowly.

exercises.name: Seated good morning
exercises.cue: Arms crossed, back long. Tip forward from your hips, then sit tall.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: Squeeze your bottom and lift your hips until you're in a line from knees to shoulders.

exercises.name: Broom hinge
exercises.cue: Keep the handle touching your head, back and bottom as you hinge forward.

exercises.name: Backpack Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Soft knees. Slide the bag down your thighs, hips back, then stand tall.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Hips back, weights close to your legs. Stop when you feel the backs of your thighs.

exercises.name: Kettlebell deadlift
exercises.cue: Bell between your feet. Push the floor away and stand up tall.

exercises.name: Hip thrust
exercises.cue: Upper back on the bench, chin tucked. Drive your hips up and squeeze.

exercises.name: Seated band chest press
exercises.cue: Band round the chair back. Press forward until your arms are long, then slowly return.

exercises.name: Wall press-up
exercises.cue: Hands on the wall at shoulder height. Bend your elbows and bring your chest towards it.

exercises.name: Counter press-up
exercises.cue: Hands on the edge, body in one line. Lower your chest to the counter.

exercises.name: Chair press-up
exercises.cue: Chair against a wall. Hands on the seat, lower with control.

exercises.name: Knee press-up
exercises.cue: Knees down, hips in line. Lower your chest between your hands.

exercises.name: Press-up
exercises.cue: Body like a plank. Lower until your chest is just above the floor.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.cue: Feet flat. Lower the weights to the sides of your chest, then press up.

exercises.name: Wall slide
exercises.cue: Forearms on the wall. Slide them up as high as is comfortable, then back down.

exercises.name: Seated bottle press
exercises.cue: Sit tall. Press the bottles overhead, then lower them to your shoulders.

exercises.name: Band overhead press
exercises.cue: Stand on the band. Press straight up, ribs down, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling dumbbell press
exercises.cue: One knee down, squeeze that side's bottom. Press up, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Standing dumbbell press
exercises.cue: Feet hip-width, ribs down. Press the weights overhead, then lower to your shoulders.

exercises.name: Machine shoulder press
exercises.cue: Back against the pad. Press the handles up, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Prone Y raise
exercises.cue: Lying face down, arms in a Y. Lift your arms a little, forehead stays low.

exercises.name: Seated band row
exercises.cue: Sit tall. Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Standing band row
exercises.cue: Soft knees, chest proud. Pull your elbows past your ribs.

exercises.name: Supported bottle row
exercises.cue: One hand on the counter, back long. Pull the bottle up towards your ribs, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
exercises.cue: Hand on the bench, back flat. Pull the weight to your hip.

exercises.name: Table row
exercises.cue: Under a sturdy table, heels down, body straight. Pull your chest to the edge.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.cue: Sit tall, knees soft. Pull the handle to your ribs, then let your arms go long.

exercises.name: Overhead band pull-apart
exercises.cue: Arms up, band taut. Pull it apart and down behind your head.

exercises.name: Seated band pull-down
exercises.cue: Band over the top of a door. Pull your elbows down to your sides.

exercises.name: Kneeling band pull-down
exercises.cue: Tall kneeling, bottom squeezed. Pull your elbows down and back.

exercises.name: Assisted pull-up
exercises.cue: Feet on the chair to take some weight. Pull your chest up towards the bar.

exercises.name: Lat pull-down
exercises.cue: Thighs under the pad. Pull the bar to your upper chest, then let it rise slowly.

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.cue: Hang long, then pull until your chin clears the bar. Lower all the way.

exercises.name: Seated knee extension
exercises.cue: Sit tall. Straighten one knee, pause, and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Supported split stance
exercises.cue: One foot forward, hand on the counter. Bend both knees a little and hold.

exercises.name: Supported split squat
exercises.cue: Lower your back knee towards the floor, then push back up.

exercises.name: Step-up
exercises.cue: Whole foot on the step. Push through it to stand up, then step down.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
exercises.cue: Step back and lower your back knee towards the floor. Push through your front foot to return.

exercises.name: Dumbbell split squat
exercises.cue: Weights by your sides. Drop your back knee straight down, then stand.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.cue: Back foot on the bench. Lower until your front thigh is nearly level.

exercises.name: Seated hold
exercises.cue: Sit tall with a bag in each hand. Shoulders back and down, breathe and hold.

exercises.name: Bottle walk
exercises.cue: A bottle in each hand. Walk tall, slow and steady.

exercises.name: Shopping bag carry
exercises.cue: A bag in each hand, shoulders down. Walk tall and keep the bags still.

exercises.name: Suitcase carry
exercises.cue: Weight in one hand. Don't let it pull you sideways.

exercises.name: Farmer's carry
exercises.cue: Heavy weights, tall posture, small steady steps.

exercises.name: Kettlebell carry
exercises.cue: Grip hard, shoulders down, walk slowly.

exercises.name: Front-rack carry
exercises.cue: Bells at your chest, elbows tucked. Breathe and walk.

exercises.name: Seated lean-back
exercises.cue: Arms crossed, sit tall. Lean back a little, hold, then come forward.

exercises.name: Heel slide
exercises.cue: Lower back gently pressed down. Slide one heel away, then back.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cue: Back flat. Reach one arm back and the opposite leg out, then swap.

exercises.name: Incline plank
exercises.cue: Hands on the counter, body in one line. Breathe and hold.

exercises.name: Knee plank
exercises.cue: Forearms down, knees down, hips in line with your shoulders. Hold.

exercises.name: Plank with reach
exercises.cue: Hold the plank and reach one arm forward without letting your hips rock.

exercises.name: Ab wheel rollout
exercises.cue: From your knees, roll out only as far as you can keep your back flat.

exercises.name: Seated band press-out
exercises.cue: Band anchored to one side. Press it out in front and don't let it turn you.

exercises.name: Seated march
exercises.cue: Sit tall, tummy braced. Lift one knee, lower, then the other.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.cue: On all fours. Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back, then swap.

exercises.name: Knee side plank
exercises.cue: On your side, knees bent. Lift your hips and hold.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.cue: Band anchored at your side, chest height. Press out and resist the turn.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.cue: Elbow under shoulder, feet stacked. Lift your hips into a straight line.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling chop
exercises.cue: Pull the band from high behind you down across your body, hips still.

exercises.name: Seated reach
exercises.cue: Sit tall, feet flat. Reach forward as far as feels steady, then sit back.

exercises.name: Feet together, with support
exercises.cue: Feet together, a hand near the counter. Stand tall and breathe.

exercises.name: Heel-to-toe stand, with support
exercises.cue: One foot directly in front of the other. Hold steady.

exercises.name: Single-leg stand, with support
exercises.cue: Lift one foot, a fingertip on the counter. Hold.

exercises.name: Heel-to-toe walk
exercises.cue: Heel touches toe with every step. Eyes ahead, arms out a little.

exercises.name: Single-leg reach
exercises.cue: Standing on one leg, tip forward and reach, back leg long. Return to tall.

exercises.name: Single-leg stand on a cushion
exercises.cue: One foot on the cushion, arms out a little. Hold steady.

exercises.name: Seated heel raise
exercises.cue: Feet flat. Lift your heels as high as you can, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Standing heel raise
exercises.cue: Fingertips on the counter. Rise onto the balls of your feet, then lower.

exercises.name: Slow heel raise on a step
exercises.cue: Balls of your feet on the edge. Lower your heels slowly below the step, then rise.

exercises.name: Single-leg heel raise, supported
exercises.cue: One foot hooked behind. Rise up, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Single-leg heel raise, 3-2-3
exercises.cue: Three seconds up, hold for two, three seconds down.

exercises.name: Weighted single-leg heel raise
exercises.cue: Weight in your free hand. Full range, slow on the way down.
